mechanism: Hydrocortisone may increase norethindrone levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and protein binding displacement, while norethindrone can enhance corticosteroid effects and increase adverse effects.
action: Monitor for signs of corticosteroid excess (fluid retention, hypertension, hyperglycemia) and consider adjusted dosing; counsel on reliable contraception as corticosteroids may theoretically reduce progestin efficacy.
